aliases: Ripe Pu-erh and snow chrysanthemum mini cake

brewing.notes: A safe starting point for ripe pu-erh: rinse once or twice, boiling water.

description:
A blend of ripe pu-erh and snow chrysanthemum, pressed into mini cakes.

Recipes for a flavoured or scented tea vary from one maker to the next, so read the ingredient list and brew it like its base tea.
processing: A ripe pu-erh base tea flavoured or scented by the maker; the recipe varies.
harvest_season: The base tea can come from any picking, so the season matters less than the recipe.
appearance_dry: Usually dark brown leaf, loose or pressed.
taste_profile: Expect what ripe pu-erh usually gives: smooth, earthy and sweet.
vintage_note: Flavoured and scented teas are not sold by vintage. Buy recent stock and drink it within a year or so, since the aroma fades.
